extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet; ES1J uses the ES1H-ES1M dotted curve in Fig. 3.
Fig. 3 points are digitized typical forward-voltage curve points at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle.

Fig. 4 points are digitized typical reverse-characteristic curve points; the plotted x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage and the plotted y-axis is instantaneous reverse current in uA. The x-axis extends beyond the ES1J rated range; VRRM and VDC for ES1J are each 600 V.
Direct compact DC table evidence: VF(max) = 1.7 V at IF = 1.0 A and IR1(max) = 2.0 uA at VR = VDC = 600 V, TA = 25 degC.
Maximum ratings for ES1J: VRRM = 600 V, VRMS = 420 V, VDC = 600 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, and IFSM = 30.0 A; Tj = -55 to +150 degC and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC.
The electrical characteristics table also publishes IR2(max) = 200 uA at VR = VDC and TA = 125 degC; the reverse_current field records the 25 degC IR1 row.
No separate breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification is published; VRRM and VDC are maximum reverse-voltage ratings, not breakdown measurements.

current.conditions: Conservative F1 package bench at 95% of the cited current; IF = 1.0 A, TA = 25 degC
